title: AgentResponse
description: The structured response an agent provider must produce. This is the ONLY shape the platform accepts from a model. It is deliberately expressible in the strict structured-output subset (every property required, additionalProperties false, no oneOf/anyOf), because that is what a provider can constrain generation against. Unused fields are sent as empty strings or empty arrays rather than omitted. 'design_facts' is the platform's lightweight project memory: what it records survives restarts and is fed back on later turns, so the same question is never asked twice. 'arguments_json' is a JSON STRING rather than an open object: strict schemas cannot express an arbitrary object, and the platform validates the parsed arguments per capability anyway.

kind.description: answer = a grounded reply with no changes. clarification = required information is missing, so nothing may be modified. plan = an ordered list of operations to apply.

message.description: What to say to the user. Required for every kind; for a plan this is the one-line summary shown in the transcript.

question.description: The single question to ask when kind is clarification. Empty otherwise.

missing_information.description: Machine-readable names of the facts that are missing, for example ceiling_height_m or plan_scale. Empty unless kind is clarification.

operations.description: Ordered operations to apply. Empty unless kind is plan.

capability.description: A platform capability name. Prefer a specific capability over execute_blender_python: specific capabilities are verified, need no approval, and are safe to retry.

label.description: Short human-readable progress label, for example 'Creating the north wall'. Shown to the user; must contain no file path or internal identifier.

arguments_json.description: A JSON object of canonical arguments for this capability, encoded as a string. Distances and dimensions in METRES, angles in RADIANS, colours as linear sRGB {r,g,b,a} in [0,1]. For execute_blender_python the only key is 'code'.

design_facts.description: Confirmed, reusable facts about the project to remember, for example ceiling_height_m = 2.4 or plan_scale = 1:50. Record a fact only once the user has stated it or it is unambiguous from a reference. Never record a guess. Empty when there is nothing new to remember.

key.description: snake_case machine-readable name, for example ceiling_height_m

value.description: The value as text. Numbers are in canonical units: metres for lengths.

assumptions.description: Assumptions you made that the user did not confirm, in plain language, so they can correct you. For example 'I assumed interior walls are 0.12 m thick'. Empty when you assumed nothing.
